async_flows.interpretation: Validated SDK capture-local ID edges; queue latency includes producer admission, scheduling and mailbox delay. Execution remains the original zone, not an extra duration. Missing/duplicate/lost endpoints are retained without inferred edges.

interpretation: Exact adjacent source markers define a half-open frame. ShadPS4 GNM marks are submission epochs, not presentation completion. Exclusive segments partition each lane, including uncovered gaps; parallel lanes, wait edges and async queue latency are NOT additive frame contributions. Reference medians describe nearby same-capture observations, not a matched-scene performance experiment. Producer work during an explicit wait is measured but is not automatically all prerequisite work. Missing boundary scopes stay unattributed; GPU query clocks require their own calibration.

cpu_gpu.interpretation: sched_switch measures on-CPU; sched_wakeup separates sleep from runnable. Non-HLE on-CPU includes guest JIT/FEX and uninstrumented host work, not a guest function identity. KGSL submit-to-retire includes queue/fence/completion reporting latency, not GPU busy. Overwritten prefixes and incomplete endpoints are excluded; independent GPU query clocks are not aligned by this sidecar.
